general_information.Description: The course provides students with basic knwoledge of smart cities. The course provides the concepts of smart city, the steps to establish a smart city from technology to management policy. Students gain background knowledge and overview of smart cities.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Student is reponsible to do all Worklabs - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU LMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - TinkerCAD - Arduino IDE - Fritzing - Sensors - Debian OS (Raspberry Pi)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Have an overview of smart city from past, present and future
Understand the definition of smart cities, needs, and challenges of smart cities
Understand the properties, structure, and fucntions of each elements for building smart cities
Understand and have knowledge of building a smart cities from zero to fully functions
Understand and have knowledge in basis of using technologies to build smart cities
Evaluate the different technologies to apply to each specific case and environment for smart cities's applications
Selecting and applying IOT/ICT technologies for building smart cities
Ability to do small project using the different technologies of IoT
